fields.description: ISS-2026-00636 / MOM 3.6 -- not reqd as of this ticket: a Custom Style request (custom_requested_style set instead) has no real catalog item behind it at all. Exactly one of item/custom_requested_style must be set -- enforced in sales.inquiry_api._create_inquiry, not here.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: ISS-2026-00636 / MOM 3.6 -- WhatsApp's "Custom Style" option: a dealer describes a design that isn't in the item master at all, free text, rather than this app inventing a placeholder Item or an ERPNext Opportunity for it. Set instead of `item`, never alongside it.
fields.label: Requested Style (Custom)

fields.description: Which of the dealer's own sales staff phoned this in -- a dealer can have several people inquiring about different items at once (client requirement 8.9). Free text, not a link: this app has no separate dealer-contacts master.

fields.description: BRD C.3.1/C.13.1 — closes the inquiry when the dealer (or staff, on their behalf) converts it straight to an order. Set once, at conversion; the dealer portal's own convert_to_order is the normal path that sets it.
fields.label: Customer PO Number

fields.description: BRD D.3 — set once, at the same moment status moves to "Converted to Order" (sales.order_api._create_order), so the conversion is traceable from the Inquiry side rather than only discoverable by searching the Sales Order for a matching custom_source_ref.
fields.label: Linked Sales Order

fields.description: Set once, at the same moment status moves to "Quoted" (sales.quotation_api.create_quotation). Several inquiries for the same dealer can merge into one quotation, so — unlike linked_sales_order — this isn't discoverable from the Quotation side (its own custom_inquiry only points at the first one); this field is the only record of it for every inquiry after the first.
fields.label: Linked Quotation

fields.description: Set once, at creation (sales.inquiry_api._mirror_to_opportunity) — the native ERPNext Opportunity this Inquiry was mirrored into, so desk staff have one list to work from instead of a separate Inquiry list. One-way, create-time only; later status changes on this Inquiry are not pushed to the Opportunity.
fields.label: Linked Opportunity
